invariants.description: Explicit activation: A privacy mechanism reported as enabled must actually participate in execution.
invariants.evidence: Fixed PRIV-0001 in simulation_service.py: when use_opacus_dp is enabled, train_local_with_opacus executes with per-sample DP-SGD and records non-null actual_epsilon.

invariants.description: No silent downgrade: Failure of a required privacy mechanism must not silently continue with weaker protection while still claiming the stronger mode.
invariants.evidence: Invalid epsilon/delta/norms fail closed at initialization; FHE key mismatches raise ValueError; TEE tamper triggers InvalidTag.

invariants.description: Configuration fidelity: Privacy configuration must control actual runtime behavior.
invariants.evidence: Config flags enable_dp, enable_sa, and hardware_isolation_mode directly branch to genuine privacy wrappers and mathematical transforms.

invariants.description: Budget integrity: Privacy budget state must correspond to privacy operations actually executed.
invariants.evidence: PrivacyBudget.spend increments round count and cumulative epsilon; exceeding limit strictly raises PrivacyBudgetExceededError.

invariants.description: Isolation: Privacy state from Simulation A must not affect Simulation B.
invariants.evidence: Privacy budgets are partitioned by simulation_id with thread-safe OrderedDict isolation; spending in sim-A leaves sim-B untouched.

invariants.description: Cryptographic randomness: Security-sensitive randomness must come from an appropriate source for its purpose.
invariants.evidence: AES-256-GCM nonces generated via os.urandom(12); KMS HMAC keys derived securely; research PRNG seeds isolated to reproducible simulation.

invariants.description: Secret non-exposure: Secret/key material must not appear in ordinary logs, API responses, telemetry, or frontend state.
invariants.evidence: Public keys, key IDs, and truncated hashes are logged; private attestation keys, AES sealing keys, and HMAC secret keys remain internal.

invariants.description: Truthful mode representation: Hardware/emulated/reference modes must remain distinguishable throughout backend and frontend representation.
invariants.evidence: AttestationReport.driver_mode sets INTEL_SGX_HARDWARE only if /dev/sgx_enclave exists, otherwise SOFTWARE_EMULATION_SANDBOX with is_hardware_backed=False.

invariants.description: Fail-closed semantics: Where privacy is mandatory, initialization or execution failure must not silently disable it.
invariants.evidence: Simulation initialization validates dp_epsilon, dp_delta, and dp_max_grad_norm early; invalid parameters abort simulation immediately.

invariants.description: FL compatibility: Privacy transformations must preserve the structural validity required by the verified FL core.
invariants.evidence: Additive zero-sum SecAgg masks cancel to machine precision (atol=1e-12), preserving exact mathematical equality with unmasked FedAvg.
